The price for the other variants - X47 Venom Base - Laser Turbo Red, X47 Venom Base - Laser Afterburner Yellow, X47 Venom Base + Shadow Cosmic Black, X47 Venom Base + Laser Turbo Red, X47 Venom Base + Laser Afterburner Yellow, X47 Venom Recon - Shadow Cosmic Black, X47 Venom Recon - Laser Turbo Red, X47 Venom Recon - Airstrik Stellar White, X47 Venom Recon - Laser Afterburner Yellow, X47 Venom Recon + Shadow Cosmic Black, X47 Venom Recon + Laser Turbo Red, X47 Venom Recon + Airstrik Stellar White and X47 Venom Recon + Laser Afterburner Yellow are Rs. 2,69,500, Rs. 2,77,500, Rs. 3,15,000, Rs. 3,19,500, Rs. 3,27,500, Rs. 3,75,000, Rs. 3,79,500, Rs. 3,82,500, Rs. 3,87,500, Rs. 3,99,900, Rs. 4,04,400, Rs. 4,07,400 and Rs. 4,12,400. The mentioned X47 Venom prices are the average ex-showroom.
Ultraviolette X47 Venom is an electric street bike available in 14 variants and 4 colours. With both front and rear disc brakes, Ultraviolette X47 Venom comes up with anti-locking braking system.

 Q: What is the on-road price of Ultraviolette X47 Venom in 2026? The 2026 on-road price of Ultraviolette X47 Venom in Delhi is Rs. 3,10,975. This Ultraviolette X47 Venom price includes the ex-showroom price, RTO and insurance charges. Q: Which is better Ultraviolette X47 Venom or Ultraviolette X47 Crossover? Ultraviolette X47 Venom is priced at Rs. 2,65,000, has a top speed of 155 kmph, range of 227 km, whereas, the price of Ultraviolette X47 Crossover is Rs. 2,49,000 with a top speed of 145 kmph, and giving a range of 211 km. Q: What are the colour options of Ultraviolette X47 Venom? Ultraviolette X47 Venom is available in 4 colours which are Shadow Cosmic Black, Laser Turbo Red, Laser Afterburner Yellow and Airstrik Stellar White. Q: What are the key specifications of Ultraviolette X47 Venom? Ultraviolette X47 Venom is an electric bike that comes with a range of 227 km, and a top speed that goes uptil 155 kmph.
